seo.title: Kuznitsa №1 — canopies, stairs and steelwork in Tashkent
seo.description: A blacksmith workshop in Sergeli: car and terrace canopies, steel-frame stairs, porch canopies, gazebo and attic frames. Load calculations, in-house painting and installation by our own crew.
seo.answer: Kuznitsa №1 is a blacksmith workshop in Sergeli (12 Yangi Sergeli St.), open Mon–Sat 8:00–18:00. A polycarbonate canopy starts at 650,000 UZS per m², a porch canopy at 2,400,000 UZS and a steel-frame staircase at 14,000,000 UZS. We calculate snow and wind loads before building; lead time is from 10 working days with a 5-year warranty on the structure.

business.street: 12 Yangi Sergeli St., Sergeli district (industrial zone)

sections.title: Kuznitsa №1
sections.subtitle: We weld and install canopies, stairs and frames for private homes. We calculate the load before we cut any metal, and we stand behind the structure for five years.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: Calculation first, welding second
sections.text: Our Sergeli workshop is 900 m² with plasma cutting, a bending machine and a paint booth. We don’t sell “a canopy in three days from whatever is in stock”: for every job an engineer calculates snow and wind loads and chooses the tube section. That is why our canopies don’t sag after winter and our stairs don’t hum underfoot.

sections.label: Specification
sections.title: What we build and what it costs
sections.intro: Prices are a guide for a typical size including painting and installation. We send a quote with load calculations within a day of measuring.

items.title: Carport
items.text: 80×80 box section, 8 mm polycarbonate or metal roofing.

items.title: Terrace canopy
items.text: Arched or mono-pitch, with gutters and lighting.

items.title: Porch canopy
items.text: Forged brackets with laminated glass or polycarbonate.

items.title: Steel-frame staircase
items.text: Stringer or mono-stringer, oak or concrete treads, railings.

items.title: Gazebo frame
items.text: A steel frame for the roof and grill area, with a foundation to spec.

items.title: Mezzanine & attic frame
items.text: Beams, columns and decking rated from 300 kg/m².

items.title: Three-car carport
items.text: 54 m², metal roofing, gutters into the storm drain, installed in 2 days.

items.title: Mono-stringer staircase
items.text: Oak treads and a glass balustrade, with no vibration at all.

items.title: Gazebo frame with a grill
items.text: 6×4 m with a tiled roof and a separate kazan area.

items.title: Measuring
items.text: An engineer visits the site, takes dimensions and checks the base.

items.title: Sketch & calculation
items.text: A drawing, load calculation and quote within one working day.

items.title: Cutting & welding
items.text: Plasma cutting and gas-shielded welding — clean seams without scale.

items.title: Painting
items.text: Sandblasting, zinc primer and powder coat in our own booth.

items.title: Installation
items.text: Our crew installs the structure and hands it over with a signed 5-year warranty.

items.quote: They sent a calculation with tube sections — the first time I’ve seen a canopy calculated rather than built “the usual way”.
items.author: Ulugbek

items.quote: The staircase has stood for a year without a creak or a hum. The fitters cleaned up down to the last shaving.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: They finished the gazebo by the start of the season, exactly as the contract said.
items.author: Aziz

items.a: From 650,000 UZS per m² including painting and installation. A single-car carport (about 18 m²) usually starts at 11,700,000 UZS; we give the exact price after the load calculation.
So the canopy carries snow and wind without sagging, and you don’t overpay for extra steel. The calculation is included in the price.
A porch canopy takes from 7 days, a carport from 10 working days, stairs and mezzanines from 3 weeks. The deadline is fixed in the contract.

items.q: Do you work outside the city?
items.a: Yes, across the whole Tashkent region. Travel outside the city is priced separately and shown in the quote in advance.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Visit the workshop
sections.text: We’ll show you finished structures and how we weld. Or leave a request and an engineer will come to measure and send you a calculation.
